records.name: Omron G5V-1 DC5 SPDT signal relay
records.description: Exact 5 V, 1 Form C through-hole relay record. Inventory selection requires the relay case to be marked 5 VDC; other coil markings are different catalog variants.

electrical_roles.description: COIL_A and COIL_B energize the non-polarized 5 V coil.
COMMON connects to NORMALLY_OPEN only while the coil is energized.
COMMON connects to NORMALLY_CLOSED while the coil is de-energized.

companions.description: Use a rated low-side driver. If the driver has integrated suppression diodes, its clamp common must connect to the relay supply; otherwise provide an external flyback clamp.

selection_rules.expression: relay case marking must identify 5 VDC before this exact record is selected
selection_rules.description: The G5V-1 family has several coil voltages with different current and resistance.

selection_rules.expression: use COMMON and NORMALLY_OPEN; leave NORMALLY_CLOSED unconnected unless requested
selection_rules.description: Transistor Tester V1 begins with the normally-open contact.

notes: This verifies the G5V-1 DC5 catalog variant, not the marking on any physical relay in the user's inventory.

records.name: STMicroelectronics ULN2803A eight-channel Darlington driver
records.description: Active-production DIP-18 eight-channel low-side Darlington array with integral suppression diodes and directly opposed input/output pins.

electrical_roles.description: Each IN_n drives the correspondingly numbered open-collector OUT_n.
A channel can drive a relay coil when its current, voltage, duty-cycle, and thermal limits are satisfied.
COM is the common cathode connection of the eight integral suppression diodes and must connect to the inductive-load supply when those clamps are used.
GND is the shared emitter return for every Darlington channel.

selection_rules.description: Channel identity is semantic even though DIP output pin numbers run in reverse order.

selection_rules.expression: COM=relay_supply when integrated flyback diodes are relied upon
selection_rules.description: Leaving COM open also leaves the integral suppression diodes unavailable.

records.name: Texas Instruments ADS1115IDGSR 16-bit I2C ADC
records.description: Bare ADS1115 IC in the DGS VSSOP-10 package. Breakout-board pull-ups, address straps, header order, and mechanics are not implied.

adc_evidence.review_note: The delta-sigma input settling limit depends on data rate, gain, source impedance, and external filtering; no single fabricated source-impedance limit is claimed.

companions.description: Place a reviewed local bypass capacitor between VDD and GND.
The bare IC does not provide bus pull-ups; size one SDA/SCL pull-up set for the complete bus.

selection_rules.description: ADDR must be tied to one of the four documented nodes.
PGA full scale does not override the input-pin absolute voltage limits.

records.name: Microchip MCP4725A0T-E/CH 12-bit I2C DAC
records.description: Bare A0-address-option MCP4725 IC in SOT-23-6. Breakout-board pull-ups, header order, level shifting, and mechanics are not implied.

interface_evidence.review_note: This interface evidence describes the bare IC; any breakout-board pull-ups or level shifting require separate module evidence.

companions.description: Place a reviewed local bypass capacitor between VDD and GND.
The bare IC requires system-level SDA/SCL pull-ups.

selection_rules.description: The A0 ordering option hard-wires A2:A1=00; the external A0 pin selects the low address bit.
The DAC reference is VDD, so output range and accuracy track the selected supply.

notes: Microchip marks MCP4725 not recommended for new designs; inventory use is supported, while new designs should consider a qualified successor.

records.name: STMicroelectronics BD139-16 NPN transistor
records.description: Exact ST gain-group -16 NPN transistor in SOT-32/TO-126 with manufacturer-verified emitter-collector-base pin order.

power_dissipation.conditions: case temperature at or below 25 C

power_semiconductor_evidence.mounting_assumptions: Quoted 12.5 W rating is case-temperature limited; an actual series-pass design requires heatsink, bias, SOA, and thermal-coupling analysis.
power_semiconductor_evidence.review_note: Pinout and headline ratings are verified. The graph-only datasheet SOA has not been normalized into a fabrication claim.

records.name: Texas Instruments CD74HC4053E triple analog multiplexer
records.description: Triple 2:1 bidirectional analog switch in PDIP-16 with break-before-make switching. This part is for the future hybrid switching design, not relay-based V1.

electrical_roles.description: A selects X0 or X1 onto common X.
B selects Y0 or Y1 onto common Y.
C selects Z0 or Z1 onto common Z.
INHIBIT high opens all three switches.

selection_rules.description: The three address inputs control independently named switch sections.
Analog signals must remain inside the powered switch rails.

notes: Texas Instruments marks the PDIP CD74HC4053E not recommended for new designs.

records.name: Generic three-terminal transistor test socket
records.description: Structurally verified 1x3 through-hole interface with neutral terminal names. Replace it with the exact ZIF socket or fixture before mechanical or fabrication promotion.

electrical_roles.description: TERMINAL_1, TERMINAL_2, and TERMINAL_3 intentionally carry no base/collector/emitter assumption.

notes: This is not evidence for any particular ZIF socket body, row spacing, retention mechanism, or mounting geometry.

records.name: Provisional generic 38-pin ESP32-DevKitC-compatible board
records.description: Schematic-draft surrogate for common CP2102 boards carrying ESP-32D/ESP-32S-style module markings. Header order and physical geometry must be checked against the actual HiLetgo board before connectivity or PCB use.

properties.name: USB Interface
properties.value: CP2102 reported by user; board marking not yet captured

selection_rules.expression: actual board photographs, header labels, row spacing, outline, and mounting features required
selection_rules.description: DevKitC-compatible boards are not mechanically universal.

selection_rules.expression: use exactly one of USB, 5V header, or 3V3 header power
selection_rules.description: The reference DevKitC documentation warns against simultaneous power sources.
These ESP32 functions must not receive generated output roles.

selection_rules.expression: GPIO6,GPIO7,GPIO8,GPIO9,GPIO10,GPIO11 are exposed but reserved for module flash
selection_rules.description: Reference-board D0/D1/D2/D3/CMD/CLK header pins are not general-purpose design resources.

notes: Pin numbers are a schematic surrogate for the reference J2/J3 row order, not a verified HiLetgo header identity.
This footprint is deliberately not the development-board footprint and must never be used for PCB placement.
The exact HiLetgo revision, module, USB-UART chip, header order, dimensions, and row spacing remain unverified.

records.name: Provisional ADS1115 I2C ADC module
records.description: Logical schematic interface for an unidentified ADS1115 plug-in module. It is not connectivity-ready until the actual board header order, address straps, pull-ups, supply circuit, and mechanics are captured.

selection_rules.expression: require board photos or purchasing record plus continuity-checked header order before connectivity use
selection_rules.description: ADS1115 breakout layouts are not universal.

notes: Pin sequence is logical only and is not the physical module header order.
This is not a module footprint.
The verified bare IC record is adc.ti.ads1115idgsr.vssop10; it does not establish this module's board-level behavior.

records.name: Provisional MCP4725 I2C DAC module
records.description: Logical schematic interface for an unidentified MCP4725 plug-in module. Header order, installed pull-ups, address option, output terminal, and mechanics remain unverified. A0 is intentionally optional because an unidentified module may strap it internally or may not expose it.

selection_rules.expression: require board photos or purchasing record plus continuity-checked header order before connectivity use
selection_rules.description: MCP4725 breakout address options and board circuitry vary.

selection_rules.expression: bare IC VOUT is proportional to VDD; module-level range must be measured or sourced
selection_rules.description: Do not inherit bare-IC behavior through unknown level shifting or output circuitry.

notes: Pin sequence is logical only and is not the physical module header order.
This is not a module footprint.
The verified bare IC record is dac.microchip.mcp4725a0t_e_ch.sot23_6; it does not establish this module's board-level behavior.

records.name: Provisional SSD1306 128x64 I2C OLED module
records.description: Logical four-wire interface for an unidentified SSD1306-class 128x64 OLED module. Resolution, address, header order, supply circuitry, dimensions, and mounting holes require actual-board evidence. WARNING: common modules use both GND-VCC and VCC-GND orders; never wire this logical sequence to hardware without checking the actual board because reversed power can destroy the module.

selection_rules.expression: require controller marking, resolution, address strap, header order, supply range, outline, and mounting-hole evidence
selection_rules.description: Four-pin SSD1306 modules are electrically and mechanically variable, including commonly reversed GND/VCC header order.

notes: Pin sequence is logical only and is not the physical module header order. Do not connect power from this sequence; common boards reverse GND and VCC.
This is not a module footprint.
No exact module manufacturer, board revision, controller marking, or mechanical drawing has been provided.
